Probity refund handoff contract 0.1

This URI identifies the Probity refund admission-to-effect evidence contract refund-handoff/0.1:

"profile": "https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-observer/contract/refund-handoff/0.1"

The contract keeps verified evidence, immutable admission, post-restart recovery, authenticated handoff, attempt, effect, outcome, reconciliation, execution manifest, and provider snapshot as separate records. Each signed record has a closed snake-case schema and a record-specific signature domain. The consumer supplies the trust snapshot and report cutoff.

The generic evidence roles keep PIC, APS, Conduit, and other producers replaceable. Removing or changing this identifier makes a refund-handoff/0.1 record nonconformant.

The reference verifier, 80-vector hostile corpus, and exact field rules are in the public conformance profile.

Every report reason URI resolves to a code below. The reason-code registry defines its claim and default evidence state. The report schema limits each claim to the applicable codes.
